subject: mathematics
concept: Combining multiple mathematical tools (algebra, geometry, statistics, calculus) within a single complex modeling project
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 math sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student maps out which mathematical tools from across their years of study apply to different parts of a complex project
exercise.abstract: Student identifies which combination of mathematical tools a complex real-world project would require

assessment.mastery_threshold: identifies at least two genuinely different mathematical tools appropriate to different aspects of the project
misconception_flags: applies only one familiar tool to every part of the project regardless of fit

interest_binding: project theme generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
